# an anomaly explained away instead of tested against the mechanism

22 quarantine rejections were read as "dedup working as designed, no data loss". They were
100 lost real receipts: the idempotency preimage carries no time, so repeat edits of one file
collide.

A plausible story hid a real data-loss defect for four days -- inside the very phase built to
catch it.
